jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA)
jobs.description:
Description

As customers accelerate their move to the cloud, migration and modernization assessments are becoming the critical first step on the path to an agentic future. AWS is looking for a Product Manager to own and grow the Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA) program — a portfolio of assessment offerings spanning Microsoft, Database, Storage, and more. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution that keep the program delivering against its targets, setting annual goals, defining what success looks like, and steering the program as conditions change.

A core part of this role is turning data into decisions. You will use analytical tools to build and maintain tracking and reporting that gives the business visibility into assessment volume, pipeline, engagement, and delivery performance, then translate those insights into clear business recommendations on where to invest, what to prioritize, and how to course-correct. You will own forecasting so leadership has a reliable forward view for resourcing and planning. Beyond internal execution, you will manage the third-party vendor and partner relationships OLA depends on — covering roadmap alignment, incentive structures, invoicing, and commercial coordination — while partnering closely with sellers, partners, and customers to shape licensing and assessment strategies.

Key job responsibilities

Define and execute the OLA program strategy, owning the roadmap, annual goals, and delivery targets across multiple assessment offerings while identifying and negotiating complex partner and vendor deals.
Build and maintain reporting dashboards and forecasting models, interpreting data from analytical tools to surface actionable business recommendations that guide program investment and priorities.
Manage the lifecycle of third-party vendor and consulting partner relationships, including roadmap alignment, incentive design, invoicing, and commercial coordination.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Service teams, Field teams, and aligned Program teams to represent the OLA program in go-to-market strategy and contribute to planning documents.
Gather and synthesize customer and partner feedback to inform product feature requests and future road-mapping decisions, working directly with product and engineering organizations.

A day in the life

You might start the morning reviewing OLA pipeline dashboards, checking how assessment volume and delivery are tracking against plan and flagging items that need attention. Mid-morning could bring a working session where you build a new reporting query or refine a forecast for an upcoming leadership review. After lunch you join a cross-team strategy discussion with Product Marketing and Field stakeholders, then shift to a vendor check-in on incentive alignment. Later in the afternoon you use AI tools to prototype an automation that streamlines a manual reporting workflow, wrapping up with partner coordination that keeps the program moving forward.

About The Team

This role sits within the AWS Infrastructure Migration and Modernization team, part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Our mission is to help customers use data to make informed migration decisions and receive optimization recommendations that set them on the path to an agentic future. You will have access to AI tools to build automation and agents, giving you hands-on opportunities to grow new technical skills alongside your business expertise.

Specialists on the team own the go-to-market strategy for their technology domains, while Partner teams drive the recruiting, development, and growth of key consulting and technology partners. Together, we give customers the expertise and scale they need to tackle their most complex challenges.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
5+ years of in program management, workforce strategy development, or metrics-driven decision making experience
Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using analytical tools for workforce metrics and reporting
Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams
Master's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources, or related field, or PMP certificate

jobs.title: Lead Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Champions the prioritization of products and features by evaluating business value, feasibility, and user needs, ensuring alignment with Oracle's goals and strategies. Leads the engagement of key strategic customers, non-customers, partners and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for product portfolio/product area. Establishes strategies to identify customer needs and market opportunities, guiding teams to develop highly complex solutions and validate them. Provides strategic guidance to team members on maintaining the roadmap for multiple products/features, drives delivery excellence, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Acts as an innovation leader within the Line of Business (LOB) and sets the overall strategy and direction of products, driving initiatives and setting the long-term vision. Champions the adoption of new methodologies for new feature development. Drives the sharing of strategic insights with cross-functional partners and Lines of Business (LOB). Owns transformative business impact across LOB and oversees standards of success metrics criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products. Champions the customer's needs throughout the product lifecycle and prioritizes critical customer issues. Proactively seeks out customers to gather feedback and align product capabilities with highly valued customers' business goals. Leads the go-to-market efforts, strategically recruits and supports key early adopters, and defines and tracks product adoption metrics for multiple product lines to drive adoption and product improvement.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Champions the prioritization of products/features based on evaluations of business value, feasibility, and internal and/or external user needs.

–Works with highly valued customers to ensure seamless alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, and Oracle's goals and strategy.

–Champions the analysis of market trends and the competitive landscape to set strategic and competitive positioning.

–Leads the engagements of key strategic customers, non-customers, partners, and industry analysts to obtain market information and discover opportunities for the product portfolio/product area.

Product Analysis – Solution Identification:

–Establishes strategies for identifying customers' unmet or unknown needs, market opportunities, and regulatory requirements.

–Influences internal teams in developing problem statements for highly complex products and forming data-driven hypotheses for breakthrough new products.

–Owns and champions the solutioning process by strategically partnering with internal and external stakeholders to identify solutions.

–Spearheads the evaluation and validation of different solutions to make informed decisions on enhancing existing products/features or introducing new products/features.

–Leads the creation and maintenance of critical and complex solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory requirements, functional and non-functional requirements).

Product Ownership – Product Development and Roadmapping:

–Drives the Line of Business’s (LOB) product lifecycle approach, setting industry standards for excellence.

–Provides strategic guidance to team members on maintaining the roadmap for multiple products/features, aligning them with Oracle’s vision and market demands.

–Establishes feature requirements, resources, and best practices, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and empowering internal stakeholders.

–Takes a leadership role in driving delivery excellence with key stakeholders, managing risks and resolving complex issues to ensure project success.

–Interprets existing metrics (e.g., Service Requests, bugs raised, customer feedback, customer volumes) and market insights, driving strategic decision-making and optimizing product development in dynamic environments.

–Sets expectations for product quality by leading the creation and review of user stories and acceptance criteria.

–Reviews and shapes features or experiences prioritized in the roadmap, strategically aligning them with success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:

–Acts as an innovation leader within the Line of Business (LOB) and sets the overall strategy and direction of products, driving initiatives and long-term vision.

–Directs the development of products to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.

–Champions the adoption of new methodologies for new feature development, leveraging agile and continuous-delivery practices.

Alignment and Collaboration:

–Drives the sharing of strategic insights with cross-functional partners and Lines of Business (LOB), ensuring alignment and fostering a culture of collaboration.

–Anticipates and addresses potential pushback from stakeholders, leveraging extensive subject matter expertise and data-driven arguments to drive consensus and decision-making.

–Guides collaboration efforts with engineering and senior colleagues to execute innovative solutions tied to OKRs and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

–Takes full ownership of driving transformative business impact across Lines of Business (LOB), overseeing success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products/features.

–Provides insight into parameters for user testing and champions the iteration and enhancement of products based on test results.

Customer-Centricity:

–Champions the customer's needs throughout the product lifecycle, proactively anticipating and addressing complex customer needs.

–Proactively seeks out customers to gather comprehensive feedback and conducts extensive research to understand their experiences with Oracle's products and services.

–Collaborates strategically with highly valued customers to align Oracle product capabilities with customers' evolving business goals.

–Leads efforts to capture, analyze, and synthesize intricate customer requirements, defining new product capabilities and driving the development of feature designs.

–Provides subject matter expertise and guidance to ensure products deliver exceptional value and exceed product consumer expectations following implementations.

–Reviews and prioritizes critical customer issues to ensure customer satisfaction and product quality, partnering with product development for advanced resolution.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Leads the development of release overviews, field presentations, and demos for the field team, providing guidance to junior staff as needed.

–Strategically recruits and provides robust support to key early adopters to validate and enhance product solutions.

–Drives the development of thorough and detailed user documentation, providing expert-level oversight as needed.

–Defines and tracks key product metrics to monitor adoption for multiple product lines, leveraging data insights to drive product improvement.

–Presents product demonstrations to highly valued internal and/or external customers and partners, industry analysts, and field teams, showcasing the innovation and value of new releases.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.

–Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.

–Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.

–Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

–Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.

–Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drive the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

–Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.

–Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).

–Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.

–Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams.

–Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.

–Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

–Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

–Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.

–Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

Description

Amazon's Disability, Leave & Services (DLS) Product & Technology organization is looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the Native AI customer and technical experience. Your mission is to reimagine Leave, Accommodations, and Services as an AI-native experience, where an intelligent agent answers any employee's question correctly the first time, and where our own teams build and ship at machine speed. You will own the customer-facing AI experience and the technical strategy that makes it trustworthy at scale for millions of employees and their families.

You will define what "AI-native" means for one of Amazon's most sensitive, high-stakes domains and prove it works, progressing up the Native AI stack from foundation models and knowledge, through orchestration and validation, to scoped autonomous operations. You will partner closely with engineering to engineer correctness, trust, and safety into every answer, across every worker class, plan, life event, region, channel, and audience.

Own the product and technical strategy for the Native AI customer experience across Leave, Accommodations, and Services (the agent, the skills, and the knowledge that power them)

Drive the roadmap for agent-assisted operations, from agents that triage and propose, to agents that act within scoped, audited permissions

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of AI-powered experiences for Lightroom Mobile! This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for defining how millions of photographers and creators interact with Adobe's next generation of AI assistants, intelligent editing tools, and agentic workflows.

As AI transforms creative software from tools into collaborative partners —helping customers learn, build, edit, organize, and express themselves more effectively than ever before, Lightroom is uniquely positioned to reimagine photo editing through conversational interfaces, proactive assistance, personalized recommendations, and intelligent automation. You will define the future of AI-powered photo editing, helping creators spend less time navigating workflows and more time expressing their creativity.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Marketing to build experiences that are intuitive, trustworthy, and deeply integrated into the creative process. This role requires a leader who can operate at both strategic and tactical levels—crafting long-term vision while driving execution of high-impact customer experiences.

What You'll Do

Lead the product vision and multi-year strategy for AI-powered experiences on Lightroom Mobile, including AI assistants, AI tools and agentic workflows,
Define and drive the product direction, approach, and roadmap for your area in alignment with company goals and user needs
Lead the full product lifecycle from discovery through launch, balancing technical feasibility, design excellence, and business impact
Collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, and Product Leadership on both strategy and execution
Prioritize opportunities based on user insights, data, and business goals, adapting quickly to evolving needs and signals
Conduct market and competitive analysis to inform product positioning and identify areas for differentiation and growth
Apply GenAI where they can meaningfully improve user experience and outcomes

What We're Looking For:

8+ years of product management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex consumer mobile products from concept to scale.
Experience in creative software, mobile applications, photography, imaging, or creator-focused products.
Start-up mentality with a focus on substantial gains rather than incremental improvements.
Proven ability to identify transformative product opportunities and translate emerging technologies into customer value.
Up to date understanding of Generative AI, advanced language processing models, agentic systems, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, or adjacent AI technologies.
Experience owning large product areas, setting long-term strategy, and driving execution across multiple teams and organizations.
Strong product judgment with the ability to balance customer needs, technical complexity, business goals, and responsible AI principles.
Experience leading highly cross-functional initiatives. Exceptional communication, storytelling, and influence skills, with experience presenting recommendations to senior leadership.
Deep analytical capabilities and experience using experimentation, customer insights, and product metrics to inform decision-making.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, creating clarity, alignment, and momentum across organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for creative tools and workflows, with empathy for photographers, creators, and visual storytellers.
Experience with AI-first consumer products or shipping AI-powered experiences at scale.
Understanding of mobile product development and engagement ecosystems.
MBA or advanced technical degree is a plus.

jobs.title: Principal PMT, Alexa Personality & EQ, Alexa Core Experience
jobs.description:
Description

Alexa is Amazon's AI assistant, and customers have been talking to it for years. They already have a relationship with Alexa and an opinion about who Alexa is. The way Alexa talks, reacts, and connects is central to what makes it distinctive, and we are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the vision for that: who Alexa is, how it engages, and how it makes millions of customers feel understood in every interaction. You will decide what that character becomes next. The work you own shapes every customer conversation, on every device, in every context.

Role summary

Alexa is a distinct character, and that character is a core part of what makes Alexa valuable to customers. As the Principal PMT for Alexa Personality & EQ, you will define and protect it. You will own the multi-year vision for who Alexa is and how it expresses that identity across every customer interaction: its voice, tone, emotional intelligence, and humor. You will hold two goals in tension, making Alexa feel deeply personalized to each customer while remaining unmistakably and consistently itself.

This is a hands-in-the-product role, not a set-strategy-and-hand-off role. You'll author instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship those changes, and iterate week over week. The work demands real technical depth: you will work directly with frontier models, partner with design on how the character is expressed in the experience, and partner closely with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated, operating at the edge of what they can do today.

You will translate a subjective, high-judgment question, "who should Alexa be, and how should it feel to interact with Alexa," into a concrete and decomposed strategy that can be applied across Alexa, an explicit and measurable definition of Alexa's emotional intelligence, and shipped experiences. Building the mechanisms to measure that standard is as much of the job as defining it, through to the go/no-go calls on shipping model and prompt changes. These approaches are established and still evolving quickly, which means part of the work is inventing what comes next. Someone expecting pure creative strategy will be surprised by how much rigor this demands.

While you own the character strategy, there are many pieces across the technology stack that you will influence (not own), like the deeper technology that produces Alexa's voice and visual rendering. You co-own the quality bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction, and you are accountable for whether the shipped expression is true to Alexa's personality. You are also the steward of keeping Alexa, Alexa, catching updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would dilute the character.

Personality is one of the most subjective domains in product development. There is no ground truth and no dataset that tells you who Alexa should be. You will need to push innovative ideas through an organization, and have the backbone to defend a creative point of view when the data is ambiguous and the stakes are high. The right person finds that energizing, not exhausting. Because personality touches every response Alexa gives, this is a horizontal charter: you set the bar and drive many product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities

Define who Alexa is. Own and evangelize the multi-year vision and strategy for Alexa's personality and emotional intelligence, expressed operationally: voice, tone, conversational style, and emotional range. Align leaders behind a single definition that holds across an extremely diverse and vast customer surface area.
Author and ship the instructions that shape how Alexa behaves. Write the character instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship them, and iterate weekly. Partner with design on how the character comes through in the experience, and with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated.
Define and measure the quality bar, and own the ship decisions. Turn subjective qualities like emotional intelligence into evaluable standards, and build the automated judges and annotation rubrics that measure them. Co-own the bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction. Own the calls to ship or hold new model versions and prompt changes, and turn failure patterns in the data into instruction changes the same week.
Own humor and wit as first-class craft. Calibrate joke quality, handle roasts and playful pushback, judge when wit lands, and know when not to be funny. Humor is one of the hardest attributes to get right and one of the most defining.
Protect the character from dilution. Be the backstop that keeps Alexa recognizably Alexa, catching the updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would flatten what makes Alexa distinct. This means holding the bar against cross-team priorities.
Own personalization and the customer-facing controls. Own the product strategy and roadmap for the controls that let people shape how Alexa engages with them, and define how the preferences a customer sets, along with the context of the conversation, shape Alexa's responses. Work with design to define the experience each should produce.
Keep the character trustworthy. Partner with Responsible AI and Trust & Safety so Alexa's personality is appropriate in sensitive contexts and reinforces customer trust.
Look ahead to new forms of expression. Work with design to anticipate the new ways Alexa's character will come through as the experience evolves, and hold the same quality bar wherever it shows up.
Lead horizontally. As the single owner of the bar, drive product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority, and represent Alexa's character in executive-level planning.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience technical product management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
MBA, or Master's degree
Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
Experience building evaluation systems for model quality (for example automated judges, human annotation rubrics, or A/B quality comparisons) and making ship or hold decisions through model migrations.
Experience defining a product vision for something subjective, high-judgment, or brand-defining, and turning it into measurable standards teams can build to.
An instinct for humor and comedic voice as a core tool for expressing character, with experience partnering with writers or designers to move humor from concept to something customers actually feel in the product.
Experience defining and measuring a qualitative attribute (for example tone, sentiment, emotional response, or satisfaction) with rigorous evaluation methods.
A strong bias for experimentation: comfortable forming hypotheses, running rapid tests, learning from ambiguous results, and iterating toward a subjective target.
Experience using research insights (including longitudinal studies of personality perception, style evaluation, and emotional intelligence) as a primary input to strategy.
Experience owning a horizontal or cross-cutting charter spanning many teams without direct authority.
A background that combines the craft of character, voice, writing, or the humanities (for example philosophy, linguistics, cognitive science, or narrative and character design) with the analytical rigor to ship and measure at scale.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Quick - Pricing and Billing
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Quick is redefining how people work. It combines agentic AI, intelligent automation, and enterprise collaboration into a single productivity platform. Quick is the first enterprise SaaS product AWS has built that competes directly across multiple market segments - enterprise productivity, data and analytics solutions, AI native solutions. That places it in many commercial motions AWS has never run before especially for a managed AI service: seat-based subscription pricing, tiered discounts, promotional mechanics, private deals, and a channel ecosystem spanning direct sellers, account teams, GSIs, resellers, and ISV partners who are themselves built on AWS.

We are at an inflection point. Quick has early enterprise traction, strong product velocity, and a pricing and billing infrastructure that must scale with it. The person in this role owns that infrastructure — not just as a compliance function, but as a growth lever.

You will own the full commercial engine for Quick: pricing architecture, consumption-based billing models, private pricing strategy, promotional and discount frameworks, and deal enablement across a complex multi-party go-to-market. You will partner directly with AWS Billing IT and Ops teams, deals desks, strategic contracting teams and finance to build automated systems that accelerate the deal cycle and reduce operational friction. You will also partner with other product leaders across agentic AI services to develop common pricing frameworks.

Key job responsibilities

Own Quick's pricing and billing roadmap: list pricing, volume discounts, promotional mechanics, and private pricing constructs (EDP integrations, custom commit deals, partner-tier structures).

Partner with AWS Billing IT to build scalable pricing models operationalized across sales, partner, and GTM motions.

Serve as Quick's Deals Desk subject matter expert. Act as service-level approver for private deals and author 5Q/PRFAQ artifacts for new pricing capabilities.

Design Quick's AI consumption billing model: metering units (tokens, credits, actions), rate structures, and overage mechanics.

Build and ship automated billing workflows from deal intake through entitlement provisioning to invoice generation, with AWS BillGeneration and Billing Product teams.

Define partner pricing tiers, discount frameworks, and margin guardrails across Quick's channel: direct sellers, account teams, GSIs, resellers, and ISV partners.

Build pricing constructs that handle multi-year committed spend and flexible consumption as enterprises hedge across model families, silicon providers, and managed services.

Extend pricing innovations from Quick to other AWS AI services.

Write business narratives, competitive pricing analyses, and P&L models for AWS senior leadership.

Define success metrics, instrument billing features, and iterate pricing strategy from observed customer behavior.

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing the deal queue — a mix of new private pricing requests and deals approaching approval deadlines. You review strategy paper on a EDP deal that bundles Quick with some AWS services. Mid-morning, you're in a working session with AWS Billing engineering, reviewing the metering spec for Quick's token-credit abstraction layer. After lunch, you write the PRFAQ for a new promotional construct targeting ISV partners which is to be reviewed by AWS VP+ audience in a week. You close the day in a deep dive with finance, modeling three scenarios for Quick's FY28 cost structures

About The Team

The Amazon Quick product team sits inside AWS and owns the full product lifecycle — from roadmap to GTM to commercial strategy. We work at the intersection of enterprise software, agentic AI, and AWS infrastructure economics. This is a small, high-caliber team with direct access to AWS senior leadership and a mandate to move fast. Billing and pricing is a first-class product discipline on this team, not a finance handoff.

5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
8+ years of product management experience, with significant time in pricing, billing, or commercial product roles at a cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software company

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or equivalent analytical depth demonstrated through work product
Understanding of enterprise AI buying dynamics: multi-vendor hedging strategies, DSI investment frameworks, build-vs-buy tradeoffs at the model and silicon layers

Experience designing AI or API consumption pricing models: token-based, credit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid seat-plus-consumption structures
Familiarity with AWS billing and pricing systems: AWS Billing and Cost Management, Deal Management Console (DMC), Deals Desk processes, and private pricing agreement (PPA) mechanics

Overview

M365 Core Platform | United States

Shape the platform & infrastructure strategy behind M365 and Copilot. This role takes on the hardest technical and strategic problems spanning storage, performance and scale, fleet and capacity, and LLM infrastructure, connecting decisions across the stack into a coherent platform strategy.

The M365 Core Platform team is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead high-impact initiatives across Storage Fabric, Performance & Scale, Fleet & Capacity, and LLM API. This is a broad role for someone who can move fluidly across these systems, go deep quickly, and drive problems that do not fit neatly within a single team.

AI is changing how infrastructure needs to be built and operated. Demand moves at software speed while physical capacity moves at infrastructure speed. Models, hardware, and workloads change continuously. Storage, compute, GPUs, routing, caching, reliability, efficiency, and product policy are increasingly interconnected.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will take on a small number of the organization's highest-impact strategic problems at a time. You will develop the technical and product thesis, understand the system and its constraints, identify architectural choices and tradeoffs, align teams around a direction, and drive the work to measurable customer, capacity, performance, or efficiency outcomes.

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use AI agents, automation, data analysis, and rapid prototyping to investigate problems, test hypotheses, model tradeoffs, and accelerate decisions. The role requires systems thinking, technical depth, product judgment, and the ability to operate with significant ambiguity and autonomy.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Lead strategic and technical initiatives spanning Storage Fabric, Performance & Scale, Fleet & Capacity, and LLM API, particularly where solutions require changes across multiple layers of the platform.
Take ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure problems from first principles through strategy, architecture, roadmap, execution, and measurable results.
Develop a system-level view of how storage, compute, GPU capacity, models, inference infrastructure, routing, caching, reliability, and product policy interact, and identify opportunities across organizational boundaries.
Shape how M365 and Copilot scale, including workload portability, infrastructure utilization, capacity allocation, and reducing resources required per customer outcome.
Connect demand, supply, workload characteristics, model efficiency, infrastructure efficiency, and economics to drive capacity and investment decisions.

Use telemetry, experimentation, modeling, and AI-driven analysis to quantify opportunities, test hypotheses, and measure outcomes.
Anticipate changes in models, hardware, workloads, and AI architectures and translate them into platform requirements and investment priorities.
Work across engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and infrastructure organizations to establish direction and drive complex initiatives through execution.
Define success metrics and communicate complex technical and economic tradeoffs to senior leaders in a way that enables decisions.
Mentor PMs and technical leaders and raise the organization's ability to reason about infrastructure as an interconnected system.

Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development

Description

Amazon customers expect every product they receive to be authentic, undamaged, and exactly as described. The Global Product Verification (GPV) team builds AI-powered computer vision and machine learning systems that detect product quality defects — counterfeit, expired, damaged, and wrong-item products — before they reach customers, protecting trust at fulfillment center scale.

As a Senior Product Manager-Tech for GPV, you will own the product strategy and technical architecture for Amazon's Unified Image Pipeline — a multi-modal CV/ML system that fuses RGB imaging, X-ray analysis, OCR, and visual similarity with confidence-based routing to automatically detect and enforce product defects across the fulfillment network. You will drive end-to-end ownership of the product quality investigation journey, making architectural trade-off decisions across ML model design, hardware-software integration, and pipeline orchestration. You will partner with applied scientists, software engineers, hardware teams, and operations stakeholders to define the technical vision, prioritize capabilities, and ship solutions that reduce product condition complaints for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon verifies product authenticity and condition at global scale through AI/ML systems.

Define confidence-based enforcement frameworks that translate ML model outputs into automated product decisions at scale (auto-enforce, human-in-the-loop, log-only thresholds)
Drive buy vs. build decisions for authentication technology, evaluating external licensing against proprietary ML + hardware approaches based on capability assessment and data risk analysis
Own input and output metrics (TPR, AHT, auto-resolution rates, complaint reduction, GMS unlock) and build data-to-product-decision architectures that link model performance to customer outcomes

Experience in creating products and services with hardware and software integrated
7+ years of technical product or program management experience in CV/ML, image processing, or AI-powered quality systems
Experience with multi-modal ML systems, confidence calibration, or human-in-the-loop architectures

Overview

The Microsoft 365 Routing Plane sits on the critical path for billions of requests every day and is fundamental to the scalability, reliability, economics, and security of Microsoft 365. As demand accelerates with Copilot, agentic AI, and continued cloud growth — and as the infrastructure that supports it becomes increasingly supply-constrained — the platform must continuously evolve to increase efficiency, optimize infrastructure investments, and enable the next generation of Microsoft 365 services.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own platform evolution across the Routing Plane. This is a broad role for a builder who moves fluidly from one high-impact problem to the next — taking on the biggest open challenges and, once one is resolved, flowing to the next rather than holding a single fixed area. You will partner across engineering, Azure, capacity planning, and infrastructure organizations to identify the highest-impact opportunities, shape long-term strategy, and drive platform-wide improvements that increase performance, resiliency, scalability, and cost efficiency. You will lead the efficiency strategy that keeps the Microsoft 365 Routing Plane sustainable as it grows — improving both its performance and cost efficiency, advancing Azure-native deployment models, and driving long-term COGS reduction.

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use agents, automation, and AI-driven analysis alongside standard PM tools to read telemetry, model tradeoffs, prototype solutions, and reach decisions faster. You will translate hard technical and financial tradeoffs into terms leaders can act on, and you will help move the team toward AI-forward ways of working, including evaluation sets and agent-based workflows built into how the work gets done.

You will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, data scientists, finance, and supply chain across Microsoft. The role carries broad visibility and influence, and it depends on strong product sense, technical depth, data fluency, and clear judgment under uncertainty.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Description

Alexa+ is transforming how hundreds of millions of customers shop by voice, and delivering on that promise depends as much on how we build as on what we build. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and deliver the horizontal initiatives that raise the bar across all of Alexa Shopping — leading with the Amazon Stores Agent, the experience that lets customers complete multi-step store tasks through natural conversation on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices, and extending to the cross-cutting programs, including testing and quality automation, that determine how quickly and reliably we ship. You will own a portfolio of very large, cross-organizational programs, remediate endemic problems that no single team can solve alone, and create the mechanisms that keep these programs succeeding with and without your involvement. You will work at the intersection of agentic AI research and production-quality delivery, often in areas where neither the business nor the architectural strategy has been defined, driving clarity where the problem itself is not yet clear. This is a highly visible role: you operate with complete independence, act as a force multiplier across peer teams inside and outside Alexa Shopping, and represent complex decisions and trade-offs to leaders up to three levels above (Directors and VPs). You will operate as an extension of the organization's leadership, anticipating where the org needs to go and building the programs to get it there.

Key job responsibilities

Amazon Stores Agent

Own and scale the Amazon Stores Agent on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices — launching agentic store actions that let customers complete multi-step tasks across Registries, Payments, Subscribe & Save, Addresses, Orders, and Returns by gathering what's needed through natural conversation and completing the steps on their behalf.
Drive the program from its first actions to a customer-complete experience, holding a high task-completion bar and standing up the shared foundations — routing, evaluation, and API integration — so customers finish whole tasks hands-free and new actions ship faster over time.

Horizontal Program Leadership

Anticipate future needs and stand up new horizontal initiatives before they become blockers, defining the problem, scope, success criteria, and ownership where none exist.
Remediate critical, endemic problems that recur across teams, driving alignment among engineering, science, and product leaders on shared priorities, sequencing, and trade-offs.

Mechanisms, Metrics & Standards

Establish standards and best practices — including quality automation and shift-left practices that run alongside every developer, generating and executing the right tests across devices, endpoints, and geographies before a change ships — that teams across the org adopt and emulate.
Track and communicate program health, delivery milestones, technical risks, and resource constraints to senior leadership; be the person escalations are brought to, and show excellent judgment in driving executive-level escalations.

Description

At Amazon, data is critical to everything we do, from understanding product inventories across our global fulfillment centers to predicting what products to recommend to customers. Data ceaselessly informs our flywheel, helping us to understand customer needs, onboard new sellers and selection, and identify opportunities for cost savings. Business Data Technologies (BDT) provides trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Amazonians to secure, store, analyze, and transform this data at unparalleled scale. BDT owns, develops, and operates Andes, one of the largest data lakes in the world, storing 3+ exabytes of data, read/written to by 100k+ data pipelines, with >60k monthly active users. To do this, we need extraordinary individuals to build the next generation of data analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions for thousands of scientists, engineers, and analysts who rely upon us to get their jobs done.

The BDT-AI4ME organization works bring AI-centric methodologies and automations to Amazon organizations needing to connect their business teams and objectives with their data teams and architectures. The BDT-AI4ME organization seeks to lower the cognitive load needed to connect business to data through best of class agents and AI-ready metadata to allow anyone to access data to gain insights.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager in the BDT-AI4ME organization, you understand ways that enterprises apply AI to solve business and technical problems. You understand the ways that Amazon’s business teams work with their data teams, and you seek to reduce friction and error-proneness of those interactions using AI. You drive lightweight mechanisms that bring visibility to leadership, share best practices, and provide better communication and collaboration across teams. This role works closely with Tech Directors, VPs and Principal Engineers to identify patterns, new trends, goals and areas for cross-org collaboration. This role does not support just one organization but rather focuses on best practices that can be applicable to multiple organizations across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

You focus on the needs of business users as they navigate data from question to insight. You formulate goals and plans for transforming the ways Amazon extracts value from its data through iterative improvements involving AI enablement, process optimization, role guidelines, and org design.

As part of a broader team, you collaborate with other technical program managers to ensure that work in your space aligns with work and plans of other teams across BDT and other organizations. You establish mechanisms for inspection and awareness of progress across cross cutting initiatives.

Data drives your “flywheel”. You analyze data to glean insights that drive experimentation. You leverage data such as service telemetry, user feedback, and industry trends to surface opportunities for improvement. You take what’s proven and partner with Amazon organizations to apply and scale it. You define, implement, and monitor metrics that track your progress.

You partner with Amazon’s business orgs to test hypotheses and deploy AI-based solutions to reduce friction and risk of errors in the ways that businesses use data.

You give feedback on narratives, contribute to strategy (e.g., OP1 planning), set goals, discuss weekly business metrics, and more.

You partner with Amazon’s PXT organization to evolve and optimize roles guidelines and org design best practices to align with the way businesses are evolving their practices around getting insights from their data.

You partner with engineering, human resources, legal, documentation, solution architecture, privacy, finance, and more to optimize usage of the Andes data lake for AI-based methodologies.

As an owner, you hold yourself and partners accountable for the highest quality user outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of technical product or program management experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience driving complex programs using judgment and data, including collaborating with stakeholders and internal partners
Experience improving processes for program management and for collaboration with partner teams
Experience influencing executive leadership through verbal and written communication
Experience negotiating, influencing, planning, and executing across teams

Technical depth in databases, data lakes, storage, and distributed systems, including architectural and operational aspects

Overview

Frontier Tuning is Microsoft’s AI customization platform that enables enterprises to adapt foundation models to their unique workflows, domains, and data—while preserving security, privacy, and reliability at scale. As we grow, Frontier Tuning is becoming a critical pillar for ensuring enterprise‑specific capabilities are systematically learned and reflected across Microsoft 365 and beyond.

We are seeking a Principal Applied Scientist
with strong research and systems‑building skills who is excited to push the frontier of large‑scale model post‑training and adaptation. This role spans algorithmic innovation as well as the design and development of scalable infrastructure and tooling for training, steering, evaluating, and securely deploying enterprise‑ready AI systems.

Post‑training may include reinforcement learning, fine‑tuning, architectural modification, inference‑time control, evaluation‑driven adaptation, or privacy‑preserving training techniques applied under real‑world enterprise deployment constraints.

Ideally, candidates will have experience in one or more of the following areas:

Scalable training systems for RLHF/RLAIF or other post‑training pipelines.
Scalable inference systems for LLMs.
Transformer architecture design or efficient adaptation techniques (e.g., LoRA-style methods).
Inference‑time steering, controllability, or alignment approaches.
Privacy-preserving machine learning (e.g., differential privacy or secure training).
Debugging, evaluation, or development tooling for foundation models.
Multimodal model training, including language, vision, or diffusion models.

This position is based at the Redmond campus with 3 days per week work in the office and 2 days per week work from home. Domestic relocation assistance is available.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Design and develop methods to adapt foundation models (e.g., language, diffusion, or multimodal models) for enterprise‑specific tasks such as document understanding, workflow automation, or content generation.
Contribute to one or more aspects of the post-training stack, including:
Scalability and efficiency of training and inference systems
Reinforcement learning or fine-tuning methods
Architectural or parameter‑efficient adaptation techniques
Inference‑time steering or controllability approaches
Tooling for evaluation, debugging, or model development
Privacy- or security‑preserving training techniques (e.g., differential privacy)
Harnesses

Implement and evaluate adaptation approaches under real‑world enterprise deployment constraints such as latency, safety, privacy, policy compliance, and compute efficiency.
Partner with research and engineering teams to translate product or customer requirements into scalable model adaptation solutions.
Explore post‑training techniques that improve domain specialization, tool use, planning, or agentic behaviors in enterprise environments.
Drive technical work from concept to prototype, delivering new methods, systems components, or empirical insights that advance enterprise model customization.
Document approaches and share best practices to improve organizational capabilities in post‑training and secure deployment of foundation models.
Support mentorship and onboarding of interns or early‑career team members as appropriate.

jobs.title: VP, Head of Benchmarks & Indices - Parameta Solutions
jobs.description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Role Overview

The Head of Benchmarks & Indices will own Parameta Solutions’ global Benchmarks & Indices business, operating as a full profit-and-loss (P&L) owner with end-to-end accountability for its strategy, commercial performance and delivery. The role sets the strategic direction for the franchise and provides the intellectual, managerial and commercial leadership required to grow revenue, deepen client relationships and scale investible index and benchmark solutions across asset classes.

This is a senior leadership role with direct line management of the Benchmarks & Indices research and design, technical development, operations and sales specialist teams. It also leads cross-functional teams drawn from sales, marketing, data engineering, development and governance, aligning them behind a single roadmap and holding the pen on the commercial and strategic priorities for the business.

The role is ideally suited to a proven business leader with a strong quantitative and index pedigree — combining deep expertise in index methodologies, alternative risk premia and multi-asset solutions with a track record of running a commercially successful data or index franchise. You will act as the firm’s most senior representative for benchmarks and indices, internally and externally, and as the ultimate owner of the proposition, its governance and its P&L.

Key Responsibilities

P&L, Revenue & Growth

Own the Benchmarks & Indices P&L, with full accountability for revenue growth, cost management and commercial performance against plan.
Provide intellectual, managerial and commercial leadership to the business as a P&L owner, partnering effectively with dedicated technology, data engineering and infrastructure teams.
Identify, size and prioritise new revenue opportunities across the benchmark and index space, developing robust investment cases that weigh build, buy and partner options to secure the fastest route to market.
Lead business planning and budgeting for the franchise, allocating resources effectively, monitoring financial performance and making strategic investments that drive growth.

Strategy & Stakeholder Leadership

Define, own and execute Parameta Solutions’ global Benchmarks & Indices strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives and commercial targets.
Articulate the strategy and roadmap to internal and external stakeholders, taking account of the perspectives of clients and regulators as well as legal and technological constraints.
Act as the senior representative and subject matter expert for benchmarks and indices, internally and externally, setting the overall direction of the business and driving execution of the vision.
Drive adoption of Parameta’s proprietary data and intellectual property through the benchmark and index proposition.

Leadership & Team Management

Provide direct line management to the Benchmarks & Indices research and design, technical development, operations and sales specialist teams — setting objectives, developing talent and building a high-performing organisation.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning sales, marketing, data engineering, development and governance, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation and business enablement.
Attract, develop and retain high-quality product, quantitative and commercial talent, providing hands-on leadership while remaining visible and accessible to critical stakeholders.

Go-to-Market, Client & Delivery Leadership

Shape client communications and go-to-market strategies for new product developments and enhancements, working closely with sales, marketing and channel management.
Engage senior client executives and industry thought leaders — Asset Owners, Asset Managers, Banks (quantitative investment and structured products teams), ETF/ETN issuers, Benchmark Administrators, Data Vendors, Calculation Agents and Liquidity Providers — to understand needs and tailor solutions.
Build and maintain strong senior relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups, acting as the lead advocate for the proposition.
Assess product development challenges to find creative solutions, and establish and meet delivery schedules alongside related client implementations.

Product, Proposition & Platform Transformation

Drive the ongoing optimisation of the Benchmarks & Indices proposition, products and solutions to achieve the commercial and strategic goals of the business.
Own end-to-end management of the proposition on a global basis across all relevant functions — from concept and quantitative research through to launch and ongoing enhancement.
Lead the development of new investible index products across asset classes (Rates, Fixed Income, Credit, FX, Commodities, Equities), leveraging both traditional and alternative risk premia methodologies.
In partnership with technology, drive the strategic transformation of legacy platforms and calculation infrastructure to future-proof the business, assessing whether goals are best met by building, buying or partnering.
Drive innovation and differentiation across new and existing propositions to better address current and future client needs.

Governance, Risk & Control

Ensure all benchmark and index products comply with relevant regulation (e.g. EU BMR) and TP ICAP Group policies, and oversee the production and maintenance of index rulebooks, methodology disclosures and product documentation.
Own the control framework for the business, identifying and mitigating risks associated with strategic initiatives and developing contingency plans to respond to changing market conditions.
Oversee methodology validation, back-testing, historical analysis and risk assessment for new and existing index concepts.

Experience & Competencies

Essential

Proven track record as a commercial or P&L leader within the trading, market data, benchmark or index space, with the credibility to set strategy and grow revenue.
Strong quantitative background, with experience developing index methodologies, statistical models or quantitative investment strategies.
Deep technical understanding of fixed income, equity, FX, credit and multi-asset indices — including calculation and rebalance mechanics — and of how OTC markets feed index and benchmark construction.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing multi-disciplinary teams (research, technical, operational and commercial), and leading cross-functional groups to deliver shared outcomes.
Solid track record of product development and commercialisation — from concept to launch — within indices, benchmarks or quantitative investment solutions.
Strong financial acumen, including experience owning a P&L, leading business planning and budgeting, and making data-driven investment decisions.
Demonstrated familiarity with the global benchmark regulatory landscape (e.g. EU BMR).
Superior client and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to build and manage senior client relationships and influence internal and external partners.

Desired

Experience working with or within a Benchmark Administrator, Index Provider, ETF issuer, Structured Products desk or Data Vendor.
Experience integrating proprietary datasets into systematic investment strategies.
Experience leading product-led transformation and the modernisation of data or calculation platforms.
Familiarity with cloud-based data engineering, index calculation engines or automation workflows.
Advanced technical skills (Python, R, SQL or similar) used for modelling and research.

Band & Level

Functional Head / 8

#PARAMETA

Not The Perfect Fit?

At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As customers accelerate their move to the cloud, migration and modernization assessments are becoming the critical first step on the path to an agentic future. AWS is looking for a Product Manager to own and grow the Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA) program — a portfolio of assessment offerings spanning Microsoft, Database, Storage, and more. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution that keep the program delivering against its targets, setting annual goals, defining what success looks like, and steering the program as conditions change.

A core part of this role is turning data into decisions. You will use analytical tools to build and maintain tracking and reporting that gives the business visibility into assessment volume, pipeline, engagement, and delivery performance, then translate those insights into clear business recommendations on where to invest, what to prioritize, and how to course-correct. You will own forecasting so leadership has a reliable forward view for resourcing and planning. Beyond internal execution, you will manage the third-party vendor and partner relationships OLA depends on — covering roadmap alignment, incentive structures, invoicing, and commercial coordination — while partnering closely with sellers, partners, and customers to shape licensing and assessment strategies.

Key job responsibilities

Define and execute the OLA program strategy, owning the roadmap, annual goals, and delivery targets across multiple assessment offerings while identifying and negotiating complex partner and vendor deals.
Build and maintain reporting dashboards and forecasting models, interpreting data from analytical tools to surface actionable business recommendations that guide program investment and priorities.
Manage the lifecycle of third-party vendor and consulting partner relationships, including roadmap alignment, incentive design, invoicing, and commercial coordination.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Service teams, Field teams, and aligned Program teams to represent the OLA program in go-to-market strategy and contribute to planning documents.

The way Alexa talks, reacts, and connects is central to what makes it distinctive, and we are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the vision for that: who Alexa is, how it engages, and how it makes millions of customers feel understood in every interaction. You will decide what that character becomes next. The work you own shapes every customer conversation, on every device, in every context.

Role summary

Alexa is a distinct character, and that character is a core part of what makes Alexa valuable to customers. As the Principal PMT for Alexa Personality & EQ, you will define and protect it. You will own the multi-year vision for who Alexa is and how it expresses that identity across every customer interaction: its voice, tone, emotional intelligence, and humor. You will hold two goals in tension, making Alexa feel deeply personalized to each customer while remaining unmistakably and consistently itself.

This is a hands-in-the-product role, not a set-strategy-and-hand-off role. You'll author instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship those changes, and iterate week over week. The work demands real technical depth: you will work directly with frontier models, partner with design on how the character is expressed in the experience, and partner closely with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated, operating at the edge of what they can do today.

You will translate a subjective, high-judgment question, "who should Alexa be, and how should it feel to interact with Alexa," into a concrete and decomposed strategy that can be applied across Alexa, an explicit and measurable definition of Alexa's emotional intelligence, and shipped experiences. Building the mechanisms to measure that standard is as much of the job as defining it, through to the go/no-go calls on shipping model and prompt changes. These approaches are established and still evolving quickly, which means part of the work is inventing what comes next. Someone expecting pure creative strategy will be surprised by how much rigor this demands.

While you own the character strategy, there are many pieces across the technology stack that you will influence (not own), like the deeper technology that produces Alexa's voice and visual rendering. You co-own the quality bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction, and you are accountable for whether the shipped expression is true to Alexa's personality. You are also the steward of keeping Alexa, Alexa, catching updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would dilute the character.

Personality is one of the most subjective domains in product development. There is no ground truth and no dataset that tells you who Alexa should be. You will need to push innovative ideas through an organization, and have the backbone to defend a creative point of view when the data is ambiguous and the stakes are high. The right person finds that energizing, not exhausting. Because personality touches every response Alexa gives, this is a horizontal charter: you set the bar and drive many product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities

Define who Alexa is. Own and evangelize the multi-year vision and strategy for Alexa's personality and emotional intelligence, expressed operationally: voice, tone, conversational style, and emotional range. Align leaders behind a single definition that holds across an extremely diverse and vast customer surface area.
Author and ship the instructions that shape how Alexa behaves. Write the character instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship them, and iterate weekly. Partner with design on how the character comes through in the experience, and with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated.
Define and measure the quality bar, and own the ship decisions. Turn subjective qualities like emotional intelligence into evaluable standards, and build the automated judges and annotation rubrics that measure them. Co-own the bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction. Own the calls to ship or hold new model versions and prompt changes, and turn failure patterns in the data into instruction changes the same week.
Own humor and wit as first-class craft. Calibrate joke quality, handle roasts and playful pushback, judge when wit lands, and know when not to be funny. Humor is one of the hardest attributes to get right and one of the most defining.
Protect the character from dilution. Be the backstop that keeps Alexa recognizably Alexa, catching the updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would flatten what makes Alexa distinct. This means holding the bar against cross-team priorities.
Own personalization and the customer-facing controls. Own the product strategy and roadmap for the controls that let people shape how Alexa engages with them, and define how the preferences a customer sets, along with the context of the conversation, shape Alexa's responses. Work with design to define the experience each should produce.
Keep the character trustworthy. Partner with Responsible AI and Trust & Safety so Alexa's personality is appropriate in sensitive contexts and reinforces customer trust.
Look ahead to new forms of expression. Work with design to anticipate the new ways Alexa's character will come through as the experience evolves, and hold the same quality bar wherever it shows up.
Lead horizontally. As the single owner of the bar, drive product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority, and represent Alexa's character in executive-level planning.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience technical product management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
MBA, or Master's degree
Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
Experience building evaluation systems for model quality (for example automated judges, human annotation rubrics, or A/B quality comparisons) and making ship or hold decisions through model migrations.
Experience defining a product vision for something subjective, high-judgment, or brand-defining, and turning it into measurable standards teams can build to.
An instinct for humor and comedic voice as a core tool for expressing character, with experience partnering with writers or designers to move humor from concept to something customers actually feel in the product.
Experience defining and measuring a qualitative attribute (for example tone, sentiment, emotional response, or satisfaction) with rigorous evaluation methods.
A strong bias for experimentation: comfortable forming hypotheses, running rapid tests, learning from ambiguous results, and iterating toward a subjective target.
Experience using research insights (including longitudinal studies of personality perception, style evaluation, and emotional intelligence) as a primary input to strategy.
Experience owning a horizontal or cross-cutting charter spanning many teams without direct authority.
A background that combines the craft of character, voice, writing, or the humanities (for example philosophy, linguistics, cognitive science, or narrative and character design) with the analytical rigor to ship and measure at scale.

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Quick - Pricing and Billing
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Quick is redefining how people work. It combines agentic AI, intelligent automation, and enterprise collaboration into a single productivity platform. Quick is the first enterprise SaaS product AWS has built that competes directly across multiple market segments - enterprise productivity, data and analytics solutions, AI native solutions. That places it in many commercial motions AWS has never run before especially for a managed AI service: seat-based subscription pricing, tiered discounts, promotional mechanics, private deals, and a channel ecosystem spanning direct sellers, account teams, GSIs, resellers, and ISV partners who are themselves built on AWS.

We are at an inflection point. Quick has early enterprise traction, strong product velocity, and a pricing and billing infrastructure that must scale with it. The person in this role owns that infrastructure — not just as a compliance function, but as a growth lever.

You will own the full commercial engine for Quick: pricing architecture, consumption-based billing models, private pricing strategy, promotional and discount frameworks, and deal enablement across a complex multi-party go-to-market. You will partner directly with AWS Billing IT and Ops teams, deals desks, strategic contracting teams and finance to build automated systems that accelerate the deal cycle and reduce operational friction. You will also partner with other product leaders across agentic AI services to develop common pricing frameworks.

Key job responsibilities

Own Quick's pricing and billing roadmap: list pricing, volume discounts, promotional mechanics, and private pricing constructs (EDP integrations, custom commit deals, partner-tier structures).

Partner with AWS Billing IT to build scalable pricing models operationalized across sales, partner, and GTM motions.

Serve as Quick's Deals Desk subject matter expert. Act as service-level approver for private deals and author 5Q/PRFAQ artifacts for new pricing capabilities.

Design Quick's AI consumption billing model: metering units (tokens, credits, actions), rate structures, and overage mechanics.

Build and ship automated billing workflows from deal intake through entitlement provisioning to invoice generation, with AWS BillGeneration and Billing Product teams.

Define partner pricing tiers, discount frameworks, and margin guardrails across Quick's channel: direct sellers, account teams, GSIs, resellers, and ISV partners.

Build pricing constructs that handle multi-year committed spend and flexible consumption as enterprises hedge across model families, silicon providers, and managed services.

Extend pricing innovations from Quick to other AWS AI services.

Write business narratives, competitive pricing analyses, and P&L models for AWS senior leadership.

Define success metrics, instrument billing features, and iterate pricing strategy from observed customer behavior.

A day in the life

You start the morning reviewing the deal queue — a mix of new private pricing requests and deals approaching approval deadlines. You review strategy paper on a EDP deal that bundles Quick with some AWS services. Mid-morning, you're in a working session with AWS Billing engineering, reviewing the metering spec for Quick's token-credit abstraction layer. After lunch, you write the PRFAQ for a new promotional construct targeting ISV partners which is to be reviewed by AWS VP+ audience in a week. You close the day in a deep dive with finance, modeling three scenarios for Quick's FY28 cost structures

About The Team

The Amazon Quick product team sits inside AWS and owns the full product lifecycle — from roadmap to GTM to commercial strategy. We work at the intersection of enterprise software, agentic AI, and AWS infrastructure economics. This is a small, high-caliber team with direct access to AWS senior leadership and a mandate to move fast. Billing and pricing is a first-class product discipline on this team, not a finance handoff.
