5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
8+ years of product management experience, with significant time in pricing, billing, or commercial product roles at a cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software company

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or equivalent analytical depth demonstrated through work product
Understanding of enterprise AI buying dynamics: multi-vendor hedging strategies, DSI investment frameworks, build-vs-buy tradeoffs at the model and silicon layers
Experience in SaaS enterprise go-to-market — including channel economics, reseller discount frameworks, GSI co-sell structures, and EDP bundling
Experience designing AI or API consumption pricing models: token-based, credit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid seat-plus-consumption structures
Familiarity with AWS billing and pricing systems: AWS Billing and Cost Management, Deal Management Console (DMC), Deals Desk processes, and private pricing agreement (PPA) mechanics

new_jobs.description:
Overview

M365 Core Platform | United States

Shape the platform & infrastructure strategy behind M365 and Copilot. This role takes on the hardest technical and strategic problems spanning storage, performance and scale, fleet and capacity, and LLM infrastructure, connecting decisions across the stack into a coherent platform strategy.

The M365 Core Platform team is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead high-impact initiatives across Storage Fabric, Performance & Scale, Fleet & Capacity, and LLM API. This is a broad role for someone who can move fluidly across these systems, go deep quickly, and drive problems that do not fit neatly within a single team.

AI is changing how infrastructure needs to be built and operated. Demand moves at software speed while physical capacity moves at infrastructure speed. Models, hardware, and workloads change continuously. Storage, compute, GPUs, routing, caching, reliability, efficiency, and product policy are increasingly interconnected.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will take on a small number of the organization's highest-impact strategic problems at a time. You will develop the technical and product thesis, understand the system and its constraints, identify architectural choices and tradeoffs, align teams around a direction, and drive the work to measurable customer, capacity, performance, or efficiency outcomes.

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use AI agents, automation, data analysis, and rapid prototyping to investigate problems, test hypotheses, model tradeoffs, and accelerate decisions. The role requires systems thinking, technical depth, product judgment, and the ability to operate with significant ambiguity and autonomy.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Lead strategic and technical initiatives spanning Storage Fabric, Performance & Scale, Fleet & Capacity, and LLM API, particularly where solutions require changes across multiple layers of the platform.
Take ambiguous, high-impact infrastructure problems from first principles through strategy, architecture, roadmap, execution, and measurable results.
Develop a system-level view of how storage, compute, GPU capacity, models, inference infrastructure, routing, caching, reliability, and product policy interact, and identify opportunities across organizational boundaries.
Shape how M365 and Copilot scale, including workload portability, infrastructure utilization, capacity allocation, and reducing resources required per customer outcome.
Connect demand, supply, workload characteristics, model efficiency, infrastructure efficiency, and economics to drive capacity and investment decisions.
Identify architectural simplifications and platform investments that remove structural bottlenecks rather than repeatedly solving individual performance, capacity, or reliability problems.
Use telemetry, experimentation, modeling, and AI-driven analysis to quantify opportunities, test hypotheses, and measure outcomes.
Anticipate changes in models, hardware, workloads, and AI architectures and translate them into platform requirements and investment priorities.
Work across engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and infrastructure organizations to establish direction and drive complex initiatives through execution.
Define success metrics and communicate complex technical and economic tradeoffs to senior leaders in a way that enables decisions.
Mentor PMs and technical leaders and raise the organization's ability to reason about infrastructure as an interconnected system.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 15+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

6+ years experience taking a product, feature, or experience to market (e.g., design, addressing product market fit, and launch, internal tool/framework).
8+ years experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn).
8+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).
Experience leading ambiguous, high-stakes technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering organizations and technology layers. Technical depth in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, storage, compute, AI infrastructure, or large-scale online services, with the ability to reason across the broader stack.
Experience defining platform architecture, technical strategy, or multi-year investment direction for large-scale infrastructure.
Experience with LLM inference, model serving, GPU infrastructure, routing, caching, capacity management, storage, fleet management, performance engineering, or resource optimization.
Demonstrated ability to use telemetry, experiments, workload data, and economic models to guide technical and investment decisions.
A record of improving performance, scalability, reliability, infrastructure efficiency, capacity utilization, or cost through product or technical leadership.
AI fluency, including using AI agents, automation, and prototyping to accelerate analysis, technical exploration, and product work.
Solid systems thinking and the ability to develop a technical point of view from incomplete information, pressure-test it, and drive an organization toward decisions.
Exceptional cross-organizational leadership and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and business leaders without direct authority.

Description

Amazon customers expect every product they receive to be authentic, undamaged, and exactly as described. The Global Product Verification (GPV) team builds AI-powered computer vision and machine learning systems that detect product quality defects — counterfeit, expired, damaged, and wrong-item products — before they reach customers, protecting trust at fulfillment center scale.

As a Senior Product Manager-Tech for GPV, you will own the product strategy and technical architecture for Amazon's Unified Image Pipeline — a multi-modal CV/ML system that fuses RGB imaging, X-ray analysis, OCR, and visual similarity with confidence-based routing to automatically detect and enforce product defects across the fulfillment network. You will drive end-to-end ownership of the product quality investigation journey, making architectural trade-off decisions across ML model design, hardware-software integration, and pipeline orchestration. You will partner with applied scientists, software engineers, hardware teams, and operations stakeholders to define the technical vision, prioritize capabilities, and ship solutions that reduce product condition complaints for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon verifies product authenticity and condition at global scale through AI/ML systems.

Own the technical product vision and multi-year roadmap for GPV's CV/ML defect detection portfolio, including the Unified Image Pipeline, mobile investigation tools, authentication systems, and product quality trust signaling
Make architecture-level trade-off decisions across ML model design (CNN embeddings, multi-modal fusion, confidence routing), imaging modalities (RGB, X-ray, OCR), and hardware-software co-development
Define confidence-based enforcement frameworks that translate ML model outputs into automated product decisions at scale (auto-enforce, human-in-the-loop, log-only thresholds)
Drive buy vs. build decisions for authentication technology, evaluating external licensing against proprietary ML + hardware approaches based on capability assessment and data risk analysis
Own input and output metrics (TPR, AHT, auto-resolution rates, complaint reduction, GMS unlock) and build data-to-product-decision architectures that link model performance to customer outcomes

Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

new_jobs.description:
Overview

The Microsoft 365 Routing Plane sits on the critical path for billions of requests every day and is fundamental to the scalability, reliability, economics, and security of Microsoft 365. As demand accelerates with Copilot, agentic AI, and continued cloud growth — and as the infrastructure that supports it becomes increasingly supply-constrained — the platform must continuously evolve to increase efficiency, optimize infrastructure investments, and enable the next generation of Microsoft 365 services.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own platform evolution across the Routing Plane. This is a broad role for a builder who moves fluidly from one high-impact problem to the next — taking on the biggest open challenges and, once one is resolved, flowing to the next rather than holding a single fixed area. You will partner across engineering, Azure, capacity planning, and infrastructure organizations to identify the highest-impact opportunities, shape long-term strategy, and drive platform-wide improvements that increase performance, resiliency, scalability, and cost efficiency. You will lead the efficiency strategy that keeps the Microsoft 365 Routing Plane sustainable as it grows — improving both its performance and cost efficiency, advancing Azure-native deployment models, and driving long-term COGS reduction.

This is an AI-first product management role. You will use agents, automation, and AI-driven analysis alongside standard PM tools to read telemetry, model tradeoffs, prototype solutions, and reach decisions faster. You will translate hard technical and financial tradeoffs into terms leaders can act on, and you will help move the team toward AI-forward ways of working, including evaluation sets and agent-based workflows built into how the work gets done.

You will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, data scientists, finance, and supply chain across Microsoft. The role carries broad visibility and influence, and it depends on strong product sense, technical depth, data fluency, and clear judgment under uncertainty.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy for platform evolution across the M365 Routing Plane, and turn that direction into a roadmap teams can execute.
Drive platform-wide efficiency — improving how much useful work the platform delivers per unit of infrastructure, and the cost of serving it — through platform optimization, Azure-native deployment models, and long-term COGS reduction.
Take on high-impact problems across the charter, including performance, resiliency, scalability, capacity, and platform transitions, and drive them to a result.
Ensure the Routing Plane can sustainably absorb new demand from Copilot, agentic AI, and continued cloud growth within a supply-constrained infrastructure environment.
Use AI-driven analysis of demand signals, telemetry, and operational data to forecast more accurately, catch performance and reliability issues early, and fix them at the root.
Use agents, automation, and AI Ops to analyze data, coordinate work, and act on what you learn.
Model capacity, platform, and hardware tradeoffs with AI prototyping and scenario testing before committing investment, paired with solid product, engineering, and financial judgment.
Weigh cost, performance, and reliability against each other, and prioritize multi-year platform investments with partners across engineering, Azure, finance, and supply chain.
Advance Azure-native deployment and platform transition strategy, and help the platform run more efficiently as workloads grow.
Set success metrics, OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), and KPIs (key performance indicators), and shape investment priorities with leadership.
Explain complex technical and financial tradeoffs to executives in a way that leads to decisions.
Mentor other product managers and move the team toward better, AI-forward ways of working.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

A day in the life

You are the single owner of how Amazon's product identity platform reaches its customers. A typical day moves between running the operating cadence (preparing and driving business reviews), unblocking cross-team dependencies, and steering in-flight rollouts. You lean on AI-native ways of working throughout: using GenAI to synthesize customer signal, draft narratives and review docs, triage and route escalations, and automate the program mechanics that would otherwise be manual. new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, data is critical to everything we do, from understanding product inventories across our global fulfillment centers to predicting what products to recommend to customers. Data ceaselessly informs our flywheel, helping us to understand customer needs, onboard new sellers and selection, and identify opportunities for cost savings. Business Data Technologies (BDT) provides trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Amazonians to secure, store, analyze, and transform this data at unparalleled scale. BDT owns, develops, and operates Andes, one of the largest data lakes in the world, storing 3+ exabytes of data, read/written to by 100k+ data pipelines, with >60k monthly active users. To do this, we need extraordinary individuals to build the next generation of data analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions for thousands of scientists, engineers, and analysts who rely upon us to get their jobs done.

The BDT-AI4ME organization works bring AI-centric methodologies and automations to Amazon organizations needing to connect their business teams and objectives with their data teams and architectures. The BDT-AI4ME organization seeks to lower the cognitive load needed to connect business to data through best of class agents and AI-ready metadata to allow anyone to access data to gain insights.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager in the BDT-AI4ME organization, you understand ways that enterprises apply AI to solve business and technical problems. You understand the ways that Amazon’s business teams work with their data teams, and you seek to reduce friction and error-proneness of those interactions using AI. You drive lightweight mechanisms that bring visibility to leadership, share best practices, and provide better communication and collaboration across teams. This role works closely with Tech Directors, VPs and Principal Engineers to identify patterns, new trends, goals and areas for cross-org collaboration. This role does not support just one organization but rather focuses on best practices that can be applicable to multiple organizations across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

You focus on the needs of business users as they navigate data from question to insight. You formulate goals and plans for transforming the ways Amazon extracts value from its data through iterative improvements involving AI enablement, process optimization, role guidelines, and org design.

As part of a broader team, you collaborate with other technical program managers to ensure that work in your space aligns with work and plans of other teams across BDT and other organizations. You establish mechanisms for inspection and awareness of progress across cross cutting initiatives.

Data drives your “flywheel”. You analyze data to glean insights that drive experimentation. You leverage data such as service telemetry, user feedback, and industry trends to surface opportunities for improvement. You take what’s proven and partner with Amazon organizations to apply and scale it. You define, implement, and monitor metrics that track your progress.

You partner with Amazon’s business orgs to test hypotheses and deploy AI-based solutions to reduce friction and risk of errors in the ways that businesses use data.

You give feedback on narratives, contribute to strategy (e.g., OP1 planning), set goals, discuss weekly business metrics, and more.

You partner with Amazon’s PXT organization to evolve and optimize roles guidelines and org design best practices to align with the way businesses are evolving their practices around getting insights from their data.

You partner with engineering, human resources, legal, documentation, solution architecture, privacy, finance, and more to optimize usage of the Andes data lake for AI-based methodologies.

As an owner, you hold yourself and partners accountable for the highest quality user outcomes.

10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Frontier Tuning is Microsoft’s AI customization platform that enables enterprises to adapt foundation models to their unique workflows, domains, and data—while preserving security, privacy, and reliability at scale. This role spans algorithmic innovation as well as the design and development of scalable infrastructure and tooling for training, steering, evaluating, and securely deploying enterprise‑ready AI systems.

Post‑training may include reinforcement learning, fine‑tuning, architectural modification, inference‑time control, evaluation‑driven adaptation, or privacy‑preserving training techniques applied under real‑world enterprise deployment constraints.

Scalable training systems for RLHF/RLAIF or other post‑training pipelines.

Privacy-preserving machine learning (e.g., differential privacy or secure training).
Debugging, evaluation, or development tooling for foundation models.
Multimodal model training, including language, vision, or diffusion models.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. new_jobs.description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Role Overview

The Head of Benchmarks & Indices will own Parameta Solutions’ global Benchmarks & Indices business, operating as a full profit-and-loss (P&L) owner with end-to-end accountability for its strategy, commercial performance and delivery. The role sets the strategic direction for the franchise and provides the intellectual, managerial and commercial leadership required to grow revenue, deepen client relationships and scale investible index and benchmark solutions across asset classes.

This is a senior leadership role with direct line management of the Benchmarks & Indices research and design, technical development, operations and sales specialist teams. It also leads cross-functional teams drawn from sales, marketing, data engineering, development and governance, aligning them behind a single roadmap and holding the pen on the commercial and strategic priorities for the business.

The role is ideally suited to a proven business leader with a strong quantitative and index pedigree — combining deep expertise in index methodologies, alternative risk premia and multi-asset solutions with a track record of running a commercially successful data or index franchise. You will act as the firm’s most senior representative for benchmarks and indices, internally and externally, and as the ultimate owner of the proposition, its governance and its P&L.

Key Responsibilities

P&L, Revenue & Growth

Own the Benchmarks & Indices P&L, with full accountability for revenue growth, cost management and commercial performance against plan.
Provide intellectual, managerial and commercial leadership to the business as a P&L owner, partnering effectively with dedicated technology, data engineering and infrastructure teams.
Identify, size and prioritise new revenue opportunities across the benchmark and index space, developing robust investment cases that weigh build, buy and partner options to secure the fastest route to market.
Lead business planning and budgeting for the franchise, allocating resources effectively, monitoring financial performance and making strategic investments that drive growth.

Strategy & Stakeholder Leadership

Define, own and execute Parameta Solutions’ global Benchmarks & Indices strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives and commercial targets.
Articulate the strategy and roadmap to internal and external stakeholders, taking account of the perspectives of clients and regulators as well as legal and technological constraints.
Act as the senior representative and subject matter expert for benchmarks and indices, internally and externally, setting the overall direction of the business and driving execution of the vision.
Drive adoption of Parameta’s proprietary data and intellectual property through the benchmark and index proposition.

Leadership & Team Management

Provide direct line management to the Benchmarks & Indices research and design, technical development, operations and sales specialist teams — setting objectives, developing talent and building a high-performing organisation.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning sales, marketing, data engineering, development and governance, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation and business enablement.
Attract, develop and retain high-quality product, quantitative and commercial talent, providing hands-on leadership while remaining visible and accessible to critical stakeholders.

Go-to-Market, Client & Delivery Leadership

Shape client communications and go-to-market strategies for new product developments and enhancements, working closely with sales, marketing and channel management.
Engage senior client executives and industry thought leaders — Asset Owners, Asset Managers, Banks (quantitative investment and structured products teams), ETF/ETN issuers, Benchmark Administrators, Data Vendors, Calculation Agents and Liquidity Providers — to understand needs and tailor solutions.
Build and maintain strong senior relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups, acting as the lead advocate for the proposition.
Assess product development challenges to find creative solutions, and establish and meet delivery schedules alongside related client implementations.

Product, Proposition & Platform Transformation

Drive the ongoing optimisation of the Benchmarks & Indices proposition, products and solutions to achieve the commercial and strategic goals of the business.
Own end-to-end management of the proposition on a global basis across all relevant functions — from concept and quantitative research through to launch and ongoing enhancement.
Lead the development of new investible index products across asset classes (Rates, Fixed Income, Credit, FX, Commodities, Equities), leveraging both traditional and alternative risk premia methodologies.
In partnership with technology, drive the strategic transformation of legacy platforms and calculation infrastructure to future-proof the business, assessing whether goals are best met by building, buying or partnering.
Drive innovation and differentiation across new and existing propositions to better address current and future client needs.

Governance, Risk & Control

Ensure all benchmark and index products comply with relevant regulation (e.g. EU BMR) and TP ICAP Group policies, and oversee the production and maintenance of index rulebooks, methodology disclosures and product documentation.
Own the control framework for the business, identifying and mitigating risks associated with strategic initiatives and developing contingency plans to respond to changing market conditions.
Oversee methodology validation, back-testing, historical analysis and risk assessment for new and existing index concepts.

Experience & Competencies

Essential

Proven track record as a commercial or P&L leader within the trading, market data, benchmark or index space, with the credibility to set strategy and grow revenue.
Strong quantitative background, with experience developing index methodologies, statistical models or quantitative investment strategies.
Deep technical understanding of fixed income, equity, FX, credit and multi-asset indices — including calculation and rebalance mechanics — and of how OTC markets feed index and benchmark construction.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing multi-disciplinary teams (research, technical, operational and commercial), and leading cross-functional groups to deliver shared outcomes.
Solid track record of product development and commercialisation — from concept to launch — within indices, benchmarks or quantitative investment solutions.
Strong financial acumen, including experience owning a P&L, leading business planning and budgeting, and making data-driven investment decisions.
Demonstrated familiarity with the global benchmark regulatory landscape (e.g. EU BMR).
Superior client and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to build and manage senior client relationships and influence internal and external partners.

Desired

Experience working with or within a Benchmark Administrator, Index Provider, ETF issuer, Structured Products desk or Data Vendor.
Experience integrating proprietary datasets into systematic investment strategies.
Experience leading product-led transformation and the modernisation of data or calculation platforms.
Familiarity with cloud-based data engineering, index calculation engines or automation workflows.
Advanced technical skills (Python, R, SQL or similar) used for modelling and research.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI, NBS AI and OPS
new_jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a talented and technical Senior AI Product Manager to lead NBS (New Business and new sellers) AI initiatives. This senior role will spearhead AI-powered solutions to support seller growth, optimize seller recruitment and account management, and address cross-border commerce challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in AI/ML product development, with proven experience driving global initiatives across organizations. This position will identify business opportunities, develop product strategies, and orchestrate collaboration between technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners across regions. The role demands expertise in articulating business opportunities into technical requirements and translating technical concepts into business value, while managing distributed teams and leading product launches in a fast-paced environment. Success requires exceptional stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence without authority, drive alignment, and communicate effectively with senior leadership. Fluency in Chinese and English is essential, hands-on AI development and Cloud deployment competency is a plus. And understanding of cross-border e-commerce is preferred. This position offers the opportunity to shape global selling through innovative AI solutions in the dynamic NBS landscape.

Key job responsibilities

Product Strategy & Development

Lead the development of AI-driven product strategies to drive NBS AI penetration
Identify growth opportunities across seller segments and lifecycle stages
Design and implement AI solutions that enhance seller success metrics and operational efficiency
Drive efficiency and productivity of seller recruitment, account management or go-to-market activities
Lead continuous product optimization based on user feedback

Technical Leadership

Partner with data science and engineering teams to develop and implement AI/ML solutions, develop AI applications for simple use cases through vibe-coding and Amazon AI tools.
Define clear technical requirements and success metrics for AI-powered features
Oversee development cycles and ensure successful deployment of solutions
Drive data-informed decision making across product initiatives

Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional collaboration between central product and program management teams, technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners
Drive effective communication of product strategy, roadmap, and impact analysis to leadership
Manage change initiatives and stakeholder alignment across CN team and MP teams

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience as a product manager or owner
Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
Knowledge of global trade operations and compliance
